run_preprocess_race: run the script to extract paragraphs, questions, and answers from a RACE dataset directory
run_get_examples: run get_examples to extract paragraph and question-answer lists from RACE JSON files in a directory
review_InputExample: review the InputExample class that stores a paragraph, question-answer list, and label for RACE data
refactor_get_examples: refactor get_examples to support additional RACE dataset levels beyond middle and high school
summarize_main: summarize the main function that preprocesses RACE train, dev, and test sets into input and label files
